long_biography.plain_text:
Joost Schuijff helped establish two generations of Dutch internet-payment businesses while usually remaining outside the spotlight. After studying electrical engineering and physics, he worked in information technology at Insinger de Beaufort and Rabobank. In 1997 he founded Bibit with Arnout Schuijff, Robert Weaver and Pieter van der Does; its sale to Royal Bank of Scotland followed seven years later.

At Adyen, Schuijff chose the role of investor rather than day-to-day executive. He held his shares through Contentis, sold nearly half at the company’s flotation and kept a material stake as the platform expanded. Away from finance, he became a committed maxi skipper, repeatedly competing at the highest level and leading his team to overall victories in the RORC Caribbean 600.
